blocks.text: contain the welfare of your Deen and your worldly life?" "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied, "While five thousand goats are plenty, I prefer that you teach me the five phrases." Rasulullaah ﷺ then told Hadhrat Ali (RA) to recite the following:

blocks.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْلِي ذَنْبِي وَوَسِّعْ لِي خُلُقِي وَطَيِّبْ لِي كَسْبِي وَقَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَلَا تُذْهِبْ قَلْبِي إِلَى شَيْءٍ صَرَفْتَهُ عَنِّي
blocks.text: "O Allaah! Forgive my sins, make my character accommodating, make my earnings lawful, make me content with what You provide for me and never allow my heart to hanker after something that You have not decreed for me." [^1]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Teaches Adhkaar and Du'aas to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) used to teach his daughters certain words (of du'aa) and instructed them to always recite them. He mentioned that it was Hadhrat Ali (RA) who taught these to him and informed him that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to recite them whenever he faced a difficulty or was worried about something. The words were:

blocks.arabic_text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ سُبْحَانَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.text: "There is none worthy of worship but Allaah The Most Tolerant and Magnanimous. Pure is He the Most Blessed Allaah Who is the Rabb of the universe and the Rabb of the Glorious Throne. All praise belongs to Allaah the Rabb of the universe." [^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) says, "Ali (RA) once said to me, 'Dear nephew! I shall teach you some words that I heard from Rasulullaah ﷺ. Whoever recites them at the time of his death shall certainly enter Jannah. (They are) To recite three times:

blocks.arabic_text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ
blocks.text: 'There is none worthy of worship but Allaah The Most Tolerant and Magnanimous'
